result.title: Beyond the Sequentiality Bottleneck: A Hybrid Diffusion-Autoregressive Framework for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
result.summary: Autoregressive models (ARMs) face a "Sequentiality Bottleneck" in reasoning, while diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallelism but lack semantic coherence. To addresses both limitations, we propose Collaborative Reasoning Asymmetric Learning (CoRAL), a hybrid framework via an Asymmetric Planner-Executor (APE) architecture: a DLM Planner generates K diverse reasoning trajectories in parallel, while a large ARM Executor selects the optimal plan and synthesizes the final answer. To train the Planner effectively, we introduce Reward-Guided Denoising for CoT (RDC), which integrates outcome-based rewards into the diffusion process to steer it toward goal-directed reasoning. Experiments on vision-language benchmarks show that CoRAL significantly outperforms prior diffusion-based methods and achieves competitive performance against strong ARMs, achieving both superior efficiency and quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CoRAL 混合框架，由扩散语言模型 Planner 并行生成 K 条推理轨迹，再由较大的自回归 Executor 选择并综合作答，并用结果奖励引导扩散去噪（RDC）训练 Planner，在多模态视觉语言基准上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及多模态推理的生成方式与计算分配，其并行产生候选、显式筛选与结果奖励训练，可供核查「生成—选择—停止」的成本收益及轨迹监督中的贡献分配问题。
